extension.summary: Filters art-less results out of Estuary 8 streaming search.
extension.description: A small helper for the Estuary 8 skin. It proxies a streaming provider's own movie and TV-show search, reads each as a directory, drops the art-less placeholder cards the provider returns (empty posters and the "Next Page" item), and re-serves the real results with their poster, info and playable path unchanged. Movies are listed first, then TV shows. The provider add-ons are never modified; they are read exactly as Kodi would navigate them.
extension.news: [B]0.1.3[/B][CR]- The filter no longer appears as a browsable add-on in the Video add-ons list. It is an internal helper the skin invokes by path, not a content source to open by hand, so it no longer advertises a video provides. It stays installed and fully usable by the skin; only its stray listing under Videos > Add-ons is gone.[CR][B]0.1.2[/B][CR]- Search results no longer open with a back arrow as the first item. When nothing survives the art filter, or no query is supplied, the filter now serves a single "No matching results" card instead of an empty directory. Kodi's stock video window prepends a ".." parent item as the sole entry whenever a listing is empty (a fallback that ignores the show-parent-items setting), so an empty result set used to arrive as a lone back arrow; a non-empty listing avoids it. Verified on a clean Kodi 22 bench: container item one is the card, not the parent folder.[CR][B]0.1.1[/B][CR]- Search now returns Movies and TV Shows together in one poster wall, all movies first, then all TV shows. The two categories are pulled from the same provider and each is filtered for real art. The skin's two Search toggles decide which are included; both are on by default.[CR][B]0.1.0[/B][CR]- First build. Routes Estuary 8's streaming search through a filter that drops results with no real poster, so the poster wall shows only art-carrying titles and the "Next Page" placeholder card is gone. The underlying provider is read as a directory and never forked.
